name: Slugger (Combat)
body:
You are ever ready to strike.

Benefit: You may make a number of attacks of opportunity in a round equal to the number of attacks granted by your base attack bonus. This does not stack with other sources that provide additional attacks of opportunity, such as the Combat Reflexes feat.

Normal: A character without this feat can make only one attack of opportunity per round Special: The Slugger feat does not allow a rogue to use her opportunist ability more than once per round.
